title: First run the command: touch /root/limit-one   Then run the command: touch /root

messages.text: First run the command: touch /root/limit-one   Then run the command: touch /root/limit-two   Then reply with the word FINISHED

messages.note: Switched to other-free in the middle of the work: big-pickle reached its limit. The work carried on from where it was.

messages.text: Reply only with the word AGAIN
Reply only with the word LAST

OpenCode's free limit is used up until about 7:03 AM. It counts for all of OpenCode's free models together, and no model of another service is set up to take over. To keep working without this stop: Settings → add a key of another service (OpenRouter has free models, their names end in :free). The app then moves to it by itself, also in the middle of a task.
